title: Lazy Chunker with Overlap for LLM Context
instructions: Implement `chunk_words(lines, size, overlap=0)` in `chunking.py`. It lazily consumes an iterable of text lines and yields chunks of `size` words, each starting with the last `overlap` words of the previous chunk. It must validate `size` and `overlap` when called (so the public function returns a generator rather than being one), work with one-shot and endless sources, and never emit a final chunk made only of overlap words.

evidence.label: Repeats the tail of the previous chunk as overlap
Chunks span line boundaries and ignore blank lines
Splits on any whitespace and joins with single spaces
Empty or blank input yields no chunks
Never yields a trailing chunk made only of overlap words
Pulls only what it needs and can be closed early
